name: Severity counters and the severity filter on findings
description: Walks the two graded severity surfaces on seeded data. On the PR list, the FINDINGS column is present. On the PR page, the Review-runs card carries a pill row under the verdict; clicking a pill filters the findings below it and reveals the 'Show all findings' escape hatch, and clicking that restores the full list. Assertions are positive only — agent-browser's `wait --text` has no negative form, so 'the WARNING finding disappeared' is covered where it belongs, in ReviewRunAccordion.test.tsx. Read-only seeded data, no model call. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB where acme/payments-api (PR #482) is the first repo — guaranteed by e2e-web.yml; run locally via the hermetic stack (see e2e/README.md).
